displayName: sedaia-api: App Engine HTTP 5xx rate above 5 percent

documentation.content: Symptom: App Engine 5xx responses exceeded 5% for five minutes with meaningful traffic. Inspect Error Reporting and App Engine service/version logs for project sedaia-web-platform-api-508804. Roll back when errors correlate with the active version and cannot be mitigated promptly. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="appengine.googleapis.com/http/server/response_count" AND resource.type="gae_app" AND resource.label.module_id="default" AND starts_with(metric.label.response_code, "5")

conditions.displayName: At least 20 requests in five minutes
